lastCompletedStory.title: Exponential-with-jitter retry backoff in the supervisor loop

nextStoryContext: US-001 (exponential backoff + jitter) is complete. The helper computeBackoffMs is exported and tested. MAX_BACKOFF_MS=300_000 and JITTER_FRACTION=0.2 constants are in loop.ts. Both retry sites (dead-worker and no-progress) use the helper; the randomFn seam is injectable. No follow-up work is blocked. The PRD has only one story (US-001) so review should be the next sidecar action.
